{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-9098.11","title":"radio.py: LatencyRule _delayed_rx stash never expires; ghosts collide and leak","description":"## Problem

`python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py` stashes LatencyRule RX candidates in `_delayed_rx` so they survive `TxEndEvent` (`_stash_delayed_rx_candidates`, ~L352-381). Re-injection in `_get_rx_result_internal` (~L423-427) only requires `txid not in present_ids`. The latency filter (~L429-435) is a one-sided lower bound (`current >= end_time_us + added_latency_us`).

Nothing ever removes a stashed candidate except a **successful** reception (`delayed_map.pop` at ~L475).

Failure modes:

1. **Unbounded leak.** Collision (`resolve_reception` None, ~L437-471), RX timeout, never-polled node, `remove_node` (`nodes.py` ~L120-143 does not touch `_delayed_rx`), and superseded/aborted TX (`_do_start_transmission` `end_tx(previous_tx_id)` ~L141-143) all leave the entry. Every later `get_rx_result` / `deliver_pending_packets` scans the whole map (~L424).

2. **No upper bound after eligibility.** Once `end+added` has passed, the ghost remains receivable forever. A later in-flight TX at the same receiver is mixed with the stale candidate and can `record_collision`, so LatencyRule delay turns into persistent interference.

3. **Aborted TX still delivered.** Half-duplex replace ends the previous medium TX immediately, but the stash still holds the original `end_time_us` candidate and will deliver it after the original airtime+delay.

4. **No validity checks on re-injection.** Stash ignores current hop channel, `node.connected`, and whether the node still exists under that id. A re-added node id can receive a previous incarnation's delayed frame.

`SimulationBase.__init__` never initializes `_delayed_rx` (lazy via `_delayed_rx_map`); that is fine, but there is also no reset/clear path.

## Why this is robustness, not style

LatencyRule is the only reason the stash exists (`test_multihop_latency_bounds.py` `test_latency_bounded_with_added_delay`). The sequential test pops on success, so it stays green while long-running chaos / overlapping TX / node churn leaks memory and creates ghost collisions.

## Files

- `python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py` (`_delayed_rx`, `_stash_delayed_rx_candidates`, `_get_rx_result_internal`)
- `python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/nodes.py` (`remove_node`)
- `python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/event_handlers.py` (`_handle_tx_end`)

new_value: Delayed-RX stash now TTLs at end_time_us+added_us, drops on collision/capture-loser/timeout/remove_node/exit_rx/superseded TX, and does not re-inject after hop-channel mismatch or disconnect. Unpolled ghosts no longer collide with later frames; aborted TX is not delivered.
